rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the first sitting of the third National Assembly, after business resumed at 14:00, the Chief Justice took the Chair under section 86(2); Thabo Mvuyelwa Mbeki was the only nominee (nominated by N N Mapisa-Nqakula, seconded by M G P Lekota) and the Chief Justice declared him properly elected President of the Republic of South Africa.

locator.heading: ELECTION OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In the congratulatory debate the Deputy President told the President that his inauguration would fall on 27 April, together with the celebration of freedom.
